explicit_dataset_use_or_license_terms.evidence: The APSCE pages expose papers but no data; the DOI metadata has no license or related dataset entry; the reviewed institutional pages expose no dataset-use terms.

official_corpus_or_material_release.evidence: Both APSCE article pages state that download data are not yet available. No linked release was found on the reviewed official author or institutional pages or in the bounded public-repository search.

original_spontaneous_conversational_prov.evidence: The original paper documents sentences collected from student-teacher classroom mathematics discussions. It does not characterize the interaction as spontaneous. The 2012 speech follow-up says 379 selected sentences were recorded later in an office, so that speech subset cannot confirm original live-classroom audio.

preserved_independent_per_rater_annotati.evidence: The papers describe two annotators and a third adjudicator and publish aggregate agreement, but the reviewed official sources expose no per-rater annotation material.

qualifying_pre_adjudication_krippendorff.evidence: The papers publish A1-A2 raw percent agreement only. No Krippendorff-alpha point estimate or confidence interval is reported in the reviewed official sources.
